verdicts.reason: Both candidates are almost the same. Each crops into a blurry, low-resolution zoom of the background with a visible horizontal band across it. The laptops, camera and notebooks that defined the original's desk scene are gone. A huge black arc takes over the top half as an unexplained focal point, while the search bar, subtitle and CTA are crammed into the bottom third, leaving the upper area dead. The small arc wedged beside the CTA reads as a stray fragment, and it sits slightly closer to the button in B. Neither difference is enough to pick one over the other.
